newsitem.title: SPAIN: Moody's assigns Aaa to 2 BSN money market funds.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Aaa to 2 BSN money market funds.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it assigned a Aaa rating to two money market funds of BSN Dinero (FIAMM) and BSN Tesoreria Fondtesoro (FIAMM).
The rating on the two funds, managed by BSN Gestion, is the first rating for a Grupo Bank Santander de Negocios money market fund, Moody's said.
The ratings reflect management focus on investment quality and the funds' capacity to provide a necessary level of liquidity needed for requested paybacks, Moody's said in a statement.
